app.name: Snapchat
app.description: A multimedia messaging app known for ephemeral photos and videos, creative filters, and location-based features like Snap Map.

verdict.one_liner: Snapchat deletes messages by default, but tracks your interests for ads and collects detailed device data.
verdict.summary: Snapchat collects account details, content you send, usage behavior, and device information. It personalizes content and ads based on your activity. Data is shared with service providers, business partners, and anti-fraud companies. Messages delete by default within about 24 hours, and users can access deletion and ad settings.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The ephemeral messaging is a privacy plus, but Snapchat tracks your behavior for ads and collects device identifiers and installed apps. Use it with awareness and check your privacy settings.

red.title: Snap Map can share your precise location if you enable it
red.plain_english: Snapchat states that if you share your location on Snap Map, it may show your precise location to friends or suggest places in your neighborhood.

red.title: Snapchat collects detailed device and app data
red.plain_english: Snapchat states it collects device information including hardware, software, advertising identifiers, installed applications, and sensor data.

red.title: Snapchat shares data with partners and authorities
red.plain_english: Snapchat states it shares information with service providers, business partners, anti-fraud partners, affiliates, and legal authorities when required.

red.title: Snapchat keeps data as long as it says it needs it
red.plain_english: Snapchat states it keeps information as long as you tell it to, or as long as it needs it to provide services or comply with legal requirements.

green.title: Messages delete by default within about 24 hours
green.plain_english: Snapchat states its systems are designed to delete chats within 24 hours after they are opened by all recipients, unless you save them.

green.title: You can access, update, and delete your data
green.plain_english: Snapchat states you can access, update, delete your information, decide who can contact you, and download your data from within the app.

green.title: You can change advertising settings
green.plain_english: Snapchat states you can change your advertising settings in the Snapchat app.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Snapchat accesses your camera and microphone when you choose to send photos, videos, or voice messages, and during calls.
categories.detail: Camera and microphone are core to the messaging experience. The policy states they are accessed when you create or share content or during active calls.
categories.policy_excerpt: images and other information from your device's camera, photos, and microphone (like the ability to take photos, videos, view stored photos and videos, and access the microphone to record audio while recording video)

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Snapchat collects your IP address automatically, and may collect precise GPS location if you explicitly grant permission.
categories.detail: The policy states it collects location information via IP address automatically, and precise location through GPS only if you explicitly grant device-level permission. Snap Map can share your location with friends.
categories.policy_excerpt: location information (IP address). location information (precise location through methods like GPS signals)
concerns: Precise GPS location shared with friends if enabled

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Snapchat may access your device contacts if you grant permission. Other users may also upload your contact information to Snapchat.
categories.detail: The policy states device phonebook access requires explicit permission. It also notes that if another user uploads their contacts containing your information, Snapchat may combine it with other data it has about you.
categories.policy_excerpt: information about your device phonebook (contacts and related information). if another Snapchatter uploads their contact list which includes your information, we may combine that with other information we have about you
concerns: Contacts uploaded by other users without your consent

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Snapchat accesses your photos and videos when you choose to send or save them. Content saved to Memories stays on Snapchat's servers until you delete it.
categories.detail: The policy states you can send photos and videos from your device, and content saved to Memories persists until you delete it.
categories.policy_excerpt: images and other information from your device's camera, photos, and microphone
concerns: Saved media persists on servers until deleted

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Snapchat shares information with service providers, business partners, anti-fraud partners, and legal authorities. It does not explicitly state that it sells your data.
categories.detail: The policy states data is shared with service providers, business and integrated partners, anti-fraud partners, affiliates, and when required by legal process. Private communications are not shared with most partners.
categories.policy_excerpt: We share your information with our service providers.We share your information with business and integrated partners.We share your information, such as device and usage information, with industry partners working to prevent fraud
concerns: Shared with advertisers for ad measurement

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Snapchat collects your name, username, email, birthday, phone number, and profile picture when you create an account.
categories.detail: The policy states account details include name, username, email, birthday, and phone number, plus profile details like Bitmoji and profile picture.
categories.policy_excerpt: account details (information about you, like your name, username, email address, birthday, and phone number).profile details (like your Bitmoji and profile picture)

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Snapchat uses your interests, preferences, and advertising identifiers to personalize and measure ads. You can change advertising settings in the app.
categories.detail: The policy states Snapchat uses interests and preferences to personalize, target, and measure ads. It uses cookies, pixels, and unique advertising identifiers.
categories.policy_excerpt: we use your interests and preferences from the information we've collected to personalize, target, and measure ads.cookies, pixels (small graphic data that recognize user activity...), web storage, unique advertising identifiers
concerns: Behavior tracked for ads by default

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Snapchat states its services are for users 13 and older, and claims it will delete accounts if it learns a user is under 13. It does not clearly explain how it verifies age.
categories.detail: The policy states services are not directed to children under 13, and users must confirm they are 13 or older. If Snapchat has actual knowledge a user is under 13, it will delete the account.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our Services are not directed to children under the age of 13, and you must confirm that you are 13 years or older in order to create an account and use our Services. If we have actual knowledge that you are under the age of 13... we will stop providing Services to you and delete your account and data.
concerns: No clear age verification mechanism described

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Snapchat logs details about how you use its services, including access times, pages viewed, IP address, and cookies.
categories.detail: The policy states log information includes details about how you've used services, access times, pages viewed, IP address, and unique identifiers like cookies.
categories.policy_excerpt: log information (such as details about how you've used our Services, access times, pages viewed, IP address, and unique identifiers like cookies)

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Snapchat collects device information including hardware, software, advertising identifiers, installed applications, and sensor data.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly lists device information collected: hardware, software, OS, device memory, advertising identifiers, apps installed, browser type, device sensors, and wireless connections.
categories.policy_excerpt: device information (such as your hardware or software, operating system, device memory, advertising identifiers, apps installed, browser type, information from device sensors that measure the motion of your device or compasses and microphones, including whether you have headphones connected, and information about your wireless and mobile connections)

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Snapchat uses Apple's TrueDepth camera data to improve Lenses in real time, but states it does not store this information on its servers.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states TrueDepth camera information is used in real time and not stored on servers or shared with third parties.
categories.policy_excerpt: On iOS we use Apple's TrueDepth camera to improve the quality of Lenses. Note, however, that this information is used in real time — we don't store this information on our servers or share it with third parties.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Snapchat collects payment information only if you use its commerce products to make a purchase.
categories.detail: The policy states payment and related information is collected only when you use commerce products to buy something. It does not clearly explain how payment data is protected.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you use our commerce products to buy something, like those latest sneakers, we may ask you for payment and related information (like your physical address, so we can ship the product to you, payment information, so we can process the payment, and transaction history)

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can delete your account and some data, but Snapchat states it keeps information as long as it needs it for services or legal requirements.
categories.detail: The policy states information is kept as long as you tell them to, or as long as they need it. Courts or legal requirements may extend preservation. Some information may be kept in backup.
categories.policy_excerpt: we keep information as long as you tell us to, and otherwise as long as we need it.we may need to comply with legal requirements to store your data which stops us from deleting your information

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Snapchat states it will notify you of policy changes by revising the date on the policy or providing additional notice, but does not clearly explain what happens if you disagree.
categories.detail: The policy states changes may be communicated by revising the date or providing additional notice such as in-app notifications. It does not state that users can reject changes.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may change this Privacy Policy from time to time. But when we do, we'll let you know one way or another. Sometimes, we'll let you know by revising the date at the top of the Privacy Policy... Other times, we may provide you with additional notice (such as adding a statement to our websites' homepages or providing you with an in-app notification)
